audience: marketing teams that send email and SMS campaigns with ActiveTrail

useCases.title: Check credits and sending profiles
useCases.text: Read the email and SMS credit balance. Read the sender profiles the account can send campaigns from.

useCases.title: Review how an email campaign performed
useCases.text: List the email campaigns, then read one campaign's report with sent, open and click statistics.

useCases.title: Look up a contact and its activity
useCases.text: Search contacts by email or SMS text. Then read one contact's groups and its activity log.

useCases.title: Review groups and automations
useCases.text: List the contact groups and read their members. List the automations, filtered by state.

useCases.title: Add a contact to a group
useCases.text: Create a contact by email or SMS, then add it to a group. Adding can start automations. It does not send a campaign.
